tools.name: list_devices
tools.title: List device presets
tools.description: List the device presets accepted by the viewport_device argument of take_screenshot. Needs no access key.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.title: Take a screenshot
tools.description: Render a public web page and return it as an image (or a PDF, or a video of the page scrolling). Uses one screenshot of the account quota; cache hits and failed renders are free. Prefer jpeg or webp to keep the image small. A result over 6 MB comes back as a download link (valid for about a day) instead of inline data.

url.description: Full address of the page, starting with http:// or https://.

format.description: File format of the result. mp4, webm and gif record a video of the page scrolling from top to bottom.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page, not just the first screen.

viewport_width.description: Width of the browser window in pixels.

viewport_height.description: Height of the browser window in pixels.

dark_mode.description: Ask the page for its dark theme.

selector.description: Capture only the first element matching this CSS selector.

wait_until.description: Page event that marks the page as loaded.

delay.description: Extra seconds to wait after the page has loaded.

cache.description: Reuse a stored copy when the same request was made before.
